documents.title: Соглашение СССР и Финляндии о границах морских вод и континентального шельфа в Финском заливе
documents.publicationCitation: UNTS Vol. 566, I-8238, pp. 31 ff.; authentic Russian and Finnish texts; entered into force 25 May 1966.
documents.notes: Article 1 directly defines the Soviet-Finnish sea frontier by three coordinate points and straight segments. Articles 2-3 define fishing/other-zone median lines; Article 6 makes those lines the continental-shelf boundary. Article 4 states that all coordinates use the systems of Soviet charts Nos. 400, 403 and 404 (1964).

documents.title: Описательный протокол о прохождении демаркированной в 1967 году морской границы СССР и Финляндии северо-восточнее Гогланда
authority: Смешанная советско-финляндская комиссия по демаркации морской границы
documents.publicationCitation: UN Treaty Series, A-8238 descriptive protocol on the maritime boundary demarcated in 1967.
documents.notes: Confirms boundary markers Nos. 14, 15 and 16 at the three treaty coordinates; gives straight-line courses and measured distances of 4,396 m and 9,428 m between the markers. Coordinates conform to Soviet chart No. 403 (1964).

documents.title: Соглашение СССР и Финляндии о границе континентального шельфа в северо-восточной части Балтийского моря
documents.publicationCitation: UNTS Vol. 640, I-9157, pp. 111 ff.; entered into force 15 March 1968.
documents.notes: Article 1 continues the 1965 shelf line west from 59°32.0′ N, 23°10.0′ E through 59°25.2′ N, 22°45.5′ E and 59°23.1′ N, 22°10.3′ E to 59°19.0′ N, 21°47.0′ E. Article 2 states that coordinates use Soviet chart No. 444 (17 July 1965).

documents.title: Соглашение СССР и Финляндии о разграничении районов юрисдикции в области рыболовства
documents.publicationCitation: UNTS Vol. 1227, I-19806, pp. 3 ff.; entered into force 9 July 1980.
documents.notes: Article 1 adopts the 1965 and 1967 lines for fishing jurisdiction. Article 2 adds a westward coordinate-defined segment in the coordinate system of Soviet naval chart No. 1150 (1976); the 1967 endpoint 59°19′00″ N, 21°47′00″ E is expressly stated to correspond to 59°18′07″ N, 21°46′07″ E in the newer chart system, demonstrating a source-datum shift that must not be silently erased.

documents.title: Соглашение СССР и Финляндии о разграничении экономической зоны, рыболовной зоны и континентального шельфа
documents.publicationCitation: UNTS Vol. 1457, I-24645, pp. 257 ff.; entered into force 24 November 1986.
documents.notes: Article 1 expressly reuses the lines designated in the 1965, 1967 and 1980 agreements as the boundary of the economic zone, fishing zone and continental shelf; therefore it changes legal status without inventing a new geometry.
